scope: Category visual briefs for newly authored batches. Legacy pictures do not acquire compliance or human approval from this registry.

profiles.label: Cooking, food and drink
profiles.medium: Warm natural culinary close-up, realistic tactile food and tool textures
profiles.composition: Square composition, one clear teaching focus, readable at 120px; exact word meaning takes priority over decoration.
